The '''1975–76 Scottish Premier Division''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]], six points ahead of [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Dundee F.C.|Dundee]] and [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] were relegated. This was the first season of the Premier Division, the highest level of Scottish football.<ref name=afc75>[https://www.afc.co.uk/2020/03/19/1975-all-change-in-scottish-football/ 1975 | All Change in Scottish Football], Aberdeen FC, 19 March 2020</ref> The [[Scottish First Division]], previously the top flight of Scottish football became the second flight.

In an attempt to bring instant drama to the new format, the league made the unusual scheduling decision to hold an [[Old Firm]] match and an [[Edinburgh Derby]] on the opening weekend.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.scotsman.com/sport/football/competitions/premiership/opening-weekend-flashback-remembering-1975-1-3029050|title=Opening weekend flashback: Remembering 1975|date=3 August 2013|access-date=18 November 2017|publisher=The Scotsman}}</ref>
